correctness.rationale: Every weakly acyclic deterministic automaton admits one topological ordering with both transitions nondecreasing; each letter has exactly 6! =720 maps, giving a complete 720^2 universe of ordered binary maps in such coordinates. For each map pair the subset automaton on 63 nonempty subsets and backward BFS from six singleton subsets yields exact shortest lengths of every synchronizable three-subset. Independent whole-universe C++ search recovered maximum 7, four naturally ordered extremal presentations and no larger distance. Independent orbit canonicalization with all 6! state permutations and letter swap yields one class with orbit size 1440. The exhibited a=(0,2,3,4,4,5), b=(1,5,5,5,4,5), S={0,1,4} is merged by aaabaaa and independent forward BFS certifies no shorter merging word. Finite theorem is exhaustively proved by complete finite enumeration (not extrapolated).
